desktop_general.description: Use the following keyboard shortcuts to efficiently open, close, navigate, and do other tasks across the Windows desktop environment.

shortcuts.action: Set focus to the first icon in the Suggested actions menu.
Cycle through windows in the order in which they were opened.

windows_key.description: When you combine the Windows key with other keys, you can quickly do common tasks.

shortcuts.action: Open or close the Start menu.
Open the Windows 11 action center.

Minimize the active window.

Open notification center and calendar.
Lock the device orientation.
